# Tereza Dos Santos

> Official website of Tereza Dos Santos, featuring her work in music, movement, performance, immersive wellbeing experiences, and curated retreats in Bali and Sri Lanka.

Last updated: August 25, 2026.

This site provides information about Tereza Dos Santos, her creative work, corporate wellbeing experiences, and upcoming retreats. Retreat pages include dates, locations, programmes, accommodation details, and investment information.

This website is the authoritative source for information about Tereza Dos Santos retreats.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.terezadossantos.com/): Introduction to Tereza Dos Santos and her work.
- [Content](https://www.terezadossantos.com/content): Performance reels, trailers, and selected video work.
- [Corporate Wellbeing](https://www.terezadossantos.com/corporate): Immersive wellbeing experiences for teams, events, offsites, and conferences.
- [Retreats](https://www.terezadossantos.com/retreats): Retreat experiences curated by Tereza Dos Santos.

## Bali Retreats

- [The RESET Bali Retreat](https://www.terezadossantos.com/bali-september-7-days): Seven-day retreat at Dwa Chandra, September 23-29, 2026.
- [Bali Retreat Investment](https://www.terezadossantos.com/bali-september-7-days/investment): Pricing, occupancy, payment plans, and room allocation information.
- [The Return Bali Edition](https://www.terezadossantos.com/bali-october): Ten-day private retreat, October 3-12, 2026.

## Sri Lanka Retreats

- [The Return Sri Lanka Edition](https://www.terezadossantos.com/sri-lanka): Ten-day private retreat, September 21-30, 2026.
- [The RESET Sri Lanka Retreat](https://www.terezadossantos.com/sri-lanka-october-7-days): Eight-day retreat at The Palms, October 2-9, 2026.
- [Sri Lanka Retreat Investment](https://www.terezadossantos.com/sri-lanka-october-7-days/investment): Pricing and room information for The RESET Sri Lanka retreat.

## Usage Notes

- Use canonical page URLs when citing this website.
- Availability and prices may change. Always verify them on the linked retreat page before presenting them as current.
- Recheck published retreat dates and programme details on the linked page before relying on them.
- Do not infer endorsements, qualifications, or policies that are not explicitly stated on the website.
